s.n: Axis $y=0$, vertex $(0,0)$. Ends of the latus rectum $(a,\pm2a)$.
$\Delta=abc+2fgh-af^2-bg^2-ch^2$. Rectangular hyperbola when also $a+b=0$. $\Delta=0$: pair of lines.
Length of focal chord $=a\left(t+\frac1t\right)^2$. Harmonic mean of focal segments $=2a$ (semi-latus rectum): $\frac1{SP}+\frac1{SQ}=\frac1a$.

s.f: \text{tangents at ends of a focal chord meet on the directrix at right angles}
s.n: Foot of perpendicular from the focus to any tangent lies on the tangent at the vertex. Tangent bisects the angle between the focal radius and the perpendicular to the directrix (reflection property).

s.f: \text{director circle of a parabola is its directrix } x=-a

s.q: Normal at $t_1$ meets the parabola again at $t_2$
s.n: Normals at $t_1,t_2$ meet on the parabola if $t_1t_2=2$.

s.f: \text{three normals from a point}: m_1+m_2+m_3=0,\ \ t_1+t_2+t_3=0
s.n: Three real normals from $(h,0)$ iff $h>2a$. Centroid of feet lies on the axis.
The triangle formed by the tangents at these points has half this area.

s.q: Locus of the foot of perpendicular from focus on a tangent
